findings.message: Codex review of TASK-032 confirms all acceptance criteria are met. Polish-first language policy implementation is complete and properly integrated across all AI text and voice paths.

PolishFirstLanguagePolicyService enforces pl-PL for kid profiles while allowing parent non-Polish locale only when ParentalControlPolicy.language_override_allowed is true. This ensures kid-mode safety defaults are preserved.
AI text services (request_ai_creation_help_service.gd, request_gameplay_hint_service.gd) now resolve locale through PolishFirstLanguagePolicyService, ensuring consistent Polish-first behavior.

Voice governance in audio_governance_service.gd is wired to parental language policy controls. Kid voice locale is forced to Polish, parent can override only when policy allows, maintaining backward compatibility.
ElevenLabs TTS adapter includes allow_language_override in metadata payload, ensuring proper policy enforcement at the TTS layer.

Contract test coverage is comprehensive: run_task_032_tests.gd passes with Tests: 4  Checks: 45  Failed tests: 0. All services (PolishFirstLanguagePolicyService, RequestGameplayHintService, RequestAICreationHelpService, AudioGovernanceService) validated.
Handoff documentation (TASK-032-handoff-to-claude.md) thoroughly documents all changes, validation results, and acceptance criteria mapping.

summary: APPROVE. TASK-032 implementation and codex review are both complete and correct. Polish-first language policy is fully operational with proper parental controls. All acceptance criteria are met. The copilot cross review confirms all findings and validates the implementation.
